vehicle.title: Configure Vehicle
vehicle.description:
Enter your vehicle information.

⚠️ **Both fields below are required.** The tank capacity and average consumption are critical for accurate fuel calculations and trip import. Please enter the values known for your specific vehicle (e.g., from the manual or WLTP data sheet).

data.initial_consumption: Average Fuel Consumption (L/100km, e.g. WLTP value, comma or dot as decimal separator)

data_description.vehicle_name: A friendly name for your vehicle
data_description.tank_capacity: Total capacity of your fuel tank
data_description.initial_consumption: Your vehicle's average fuel consumption in liters per 100 km (e.g. the WLTP value from the manufacturer). This value is used as a fallback for trip fuel estimates when tank level data is unavailable or unreliable.

vehicle_entities.title: Configure Vehicle Entities (Optional)
vehicle_entities.description: Select existing Home Assistant entities for your vehicle data. These entities will be monitored for consumption tracking and refueling detection.

data_description.tank_level_entity: Sensor showing fuel level as percentage (0-100%)
data_description.range_entity: Sensor showing remaining driving range in kilometers

vehicle_features.title: Configure Vehicle Features
vehicle_features.description:
**The following settings are required for the respective functions:**

**Fuel Station Proximity Search during Trips** (`proximity_alerts_enabled`)
Required for: Automatic notifications when a cheap fuel station is nearby, and the Proximity Alert switch entity.
Note: If your vehicle does not provide accurate position data during trips, the configured Home Assistant coordinates will be used as the location.

**Trip Log including Position Tracking** (`trip_tracking_initial_enabled`)
Required for: Automatic trip log (Fahrtenbuch), trip statistics, and per-trip consumption analysis.
Note: Please inform all users of the vehicle that location and movement data will be recorded.

data.proximity_alerts_enabled: Enable Proximity Alerts for cheap fuel stations

data_description.proximity_alerts_enabled: Required for: automatic notifications when a cheap station is near your vehicle, and the Proximity Alert switch entity
data_description.trip_tracking_initial_enabled: Required for: automatic trip logging (Fahrtenbuch), trip statistics, and per-trip consumption analysis

prediction.title: Configure Prediction Engine (Optional)
prediction.description:
**Configure the prediction engine thresholds:**

Set the conditions for price drop notifications and fuel level warnings, and provide default daily driving distances for consumption prediction when no historical data is available.

historical_import.title: Import Historical Vehicle Data
historical_import.description:
**The following setting is required for immediate statistics:**

**Import Historical Vehicle Data** (`import_historical_data`)
Imports up to 90 days of historical data from Home Assistant's recorder (odometer, tank level, refueling events, and trips).

**What happens next?**
- The import will start automatically in the background – either **5 minutes after this setup completes** (if Home Assistant is already running) or on the **next Home Assistant start**.
- You will be notified via the Home Assistant message center (and optionally via Telegram) once the import is complete and what data was imported.
- This process runs only **once** for this vehicle.
- You can check the current status at any time in `sensor.[vehicle_name]_car_data_debug`.

data_description.import_historical_data: Import up to 90 days of historical data from Home Assistant's recorder. Required for immediate consumption statistics, refueling detection and predictions.
